result.stdout:
Meridian — semantic .NET application-flow graph generator

Usage:
  meridian scan <project-or-solution> [--output <directory>] [--include-tests] [--trust-project] [--metrics]
  meridian explain <node-or-symbol> [--graph <graph.json>]
  meridian path <source> <target> [--graph <graph.json>]
  meridian agent-summary [--graph <graph.json>] [--budget compact|standard|detailed]
  meridian mcp --graph <graph.json>

Commands:
  scan      Build meridian-out/graph.json from a .csproj, .sln, or .slnx file.
  explain   Explain a graph node from graph.json.
  path      Find a direct-call path between two graph nodes.
  agent-summary  Summarize graph.json for graph-guided agent orientation.
  mcp       Start a local MCP server over a generated graph.json file.

result.stdout:
Usage:
  meridian scan <project-or-solution> [--output <directory>] [--include-tests] [--trust-project] [--metrics]

Options:
  --output, -o       Output directory for graph.json.
  --include-tests    Include likely test projects when scanning a solution.
  --trust-project    Suppress the MSBuild trust-boundary warning for repositories you trust.
  --metrics          Write metrics.json next to graph.json.

Examples:
  meridian scan samples/Sample.BasicCalls/Sample.BasicCalls.csproj --trust-project
  meridian scan MyApp.sln --output meridian-out --trust-project

Usage:
  meridian agent-summary [--graph <graph.json>] [--budget compact|standard|detailed] [--max-items <n>] [--format text|json]

Options:
  --graph, -g       Input graph.json path. Defaults to meridian-out/graph.json.
  --budget          Approximate output budget: compact, standard, or detailed.
  --max-items       Maximum items per summary section.
  --format          Output format: text or json.

Examples:
  meridian agent-summary --graph meridian-out/graph.json
  meridian agent-summary --graph meridian-out/graph.json --budget compact
